_comment: Device limits. Conservative defaults — refine via community feedback.

_units.max_speed: position-units per second (0-100 range, so 400 = full stroke 4x/sec)
_units.max_bpm: beats per minute — max comfortable cycling rate
_units.min_cycle_ms: minimum time for one full up-down cycle in milliseconds
_units.max_acceleration: max position-units per second squared (how fast speed can change)
_units.max_delta: max position change between consecutive actions (0-100). Estim comfort/safety limit.

handy.name: The Handy
handy.notes: Linear stroker. Firmware v3 supports up to 400mm/s. Older firmware slower. Community reports 300-400 comfortable range.

osr2.name: OSR2
osr2.notes: Multi-axis servo stroker. Speed depends on build quality and servos. High-end builds exceed Handy specs.

estim_foc.name: Estim — FOC
estim_foc.notes: Single-channel estim. No mechanical limits — electrical signal. Max delta controls comfort: 50-70 typical. restim firmware has internal ramping (rise time 1-7, pulse width max 15) that smooths transitions, so theoretical max is 100 but practical comfort limit is lower. Pulse frequency usually capped at 100-150 Hz.

estim_stereo.name: Estim — Stereo
estim_stereo.notes: Dual-channel estim. Same electrical limits as FOC, two independent channels. Max delta 50-70 recommended for comfort.
